final_assessment:
Resume session, opened the morning after rc04d archived and ratified — so the first job was bringing a day-old exploration current, and three of its entries had gone stale in exactly the way the program keeps recording.

SWEPT. D-rc04c-2's headline measurement (6 capabilities / 14 requirements) is now the PRE-SPLIT figure, kept because it is what triggered R-crc-9; re-measured against the post-sync tree this stage is 3 capabilities / 9 requirements, plus 3 workflow templates, the engine, and 4 test files — counts the original entry never carried. D-rc04c-3's de-naming table is marked EXECUTED, and its `orbit-engine-gates` row flagged as NOT what shipped: that row carried the single-owner form refuted twice during rc04d's cadence, and authority now points at rc04d's archived delta rather than at this file. That row is the one rc04d's tasks 3.3 flagged and deliberately left unedited as cross-workstream; corrected here, where it is in scope. D-rc04c-4's open follow-up is answered, and pointedly: rc04d DID need its own exploration, and the premise that failed was precisely 'mechanism already worked out in D-rc04c-3's table' — R-crc-7 arriving from the other direction, since inherited mechanism has not been reviewed just because it is written down.

TWO DECISIONS. D-rc04c-5 settles a tension the charter's new NON-GOAL created the same morning: rc04c must rewrite nine requirements that describe `gate_overridden`, and writing a sentence means choosing a word, so a NON-GOAL that forbids the vocabulary reframe decides nothing at the only moment it matters. The ratified line (Sal): name the successor record correctly wherever the stage is ALREADY writing new text — that is accuracy, not a rename — and hunt nowhere else, no sweep of the fingerprint, audit-drift or PR seams. What makes it enforceable is that the boundary is not WHICH WORD but WHICH TEXT, and whether a diff touches a requirement is observable. D-rc04c-6 re-reads the inherited four-red-test-files inventory at each SITE and finds three kinds of break, not four instances of one: three semantic updates, one FIXTURE-ONLY swap (emit-schema-parity:219 does not test the field at all — it crippled the payload table using `gate_overridden` merely as a convenient documented AI-supplied key, and needs only a new victim, verified available), and one test that dies with the guard it exists to exercise. The framings produce different stages, and mis-sizing conservatively is still mis-sizing.

SIZE CHECK, run preventively and CLEAN — 3 capabilities against a ceiling of 3, 9 requirements against ~12, and neither new decision moves it. Recorded because R-crc-9 has fired three times in this program on checks that found a breach, and an instrument only ever seen firing is one nobody has watched exercise its negative case.

Q-rc04c-b sharpened rather than closed: the surviving three-facts assertion should REPLACE judgement-record-fixture's body rather than arrive as a new file, and R-crc-6's descope-sweep corollary flags `orbit-run-summary-emit`'s coexistence paragraph as this stage's to sweep — prose a mechanism-only diff would leave standing. All named constructs re-verified live before being cited: validateJudgements:533, judgementOrderingCheck:958, the guard at 606-632.
